# amyAMP - Amyloidogenic-Antimicrobial Peptide Generator

A BiGAN (Bidirectional Generative Adversarial Network) based machine learning model for generating novel peptides with dual amyloidogenic and antimicrobial properties.

## Key Features
- 🧬 BiGAN architecture with WGAN-GP
- 📊 PC6 physicochemical encoding
- 🔬 Comprehensive analysis tools
- 💻 CPU-optimized for stability
- 📈 Dimensionality reduction visualizations

## Technologies
- PyTorch 2.0+
- Python 3.8+
- BioPython
- scikit-learn
